Subscript and superscript elements are preserved in output

```r title="R"
library("htmltomarkdown", character.only = TRUE)

result <- convert(html = "<p>H<sub>2</sub>O and E=mc<sup>2</sup></p>", options = ConversionOptions$default())
print(result)
```
